_comment: Pre-steps (setup prefix) prepended to every Test Step in a tab, for the QuickShift MOBILE APP. Same schema as daywork_app/pre_steps.json: key by exact tab name or feature code (F01, F02, ...); value is a flat list (whole tab) or an object keyed by scenario code (SC01, SC02, ...) with a 'default'. App default opener is 'เปิดแอป QuickShift'. F02 starts from the opener only, because its cases start from different jobs (open vs closed).
F03: กดแท็บ "งานที่สมัคร"
